notes: Essential added: custom skins, outfits and capes now show for everyone who has it
Ping Wheel: hold the ping key (middle-click by default) to ping a spot for your friends
Vein Miner: hold the vein-miner key while mining ores to mine the whole vein
Fresh Animations player and horse animations added
Your Photon look is now the default: darker nights and better colours
Running particles removed; villager and player snoring halved; fewer glowing particles on dropped items
Timber is no longer slow, and chopping works with auto-switch
@claude answers now show in public chat
The backup mod's raw 'fastback.broadcast.message' text is gone
The instance name now shows the pack version
Hearts, hunger and the hotbar show again (they fade to dim instead of hiding for good)
Unique Dark hotbar instead of the Immersive Interfaces one
New rainbow bolt icon for the instance and the server
Fixed the error spam on every launch (removed the Remove Reloading Screen mod)
MakeUp Ultra Fast shader added on Windows for lower-end PCs
